android_kotlin-1.stem: Which language does Google recommend for new Android development?

options: A declarative UI toolkit for Android at that stage
A tool for publishing apps to the store in most teams
A testing framework for Android apps
android_kotlin-2.explanation: A declarative UI toolkit for Android written in Kotlin.

android_kotlin-3.stem: Which library is the standard way to store structured data in a local SQLite database on Android?

android_kotlin-4.stem: The screen is rotated and the UI state is lost. Which component is designed to survive configuration changes?
android_kotlin-4.explanation: A ViewModel keeps UI state across configuration changes.

android_kotlin-5.stem: A network call on the main thread freezes the UI and may crash the app. What should you do?
options: Run the call in a coroutine on a background dispatcher
Increase the timeout of the HTTP client for the project
Call it from onCreate so it finishes first in day-to-day work
Wrap the call in a try and catch block
android_kotlin-5.explanation: Run it off the main thread with coroutines (for example Dispatchers.IO).

flutter_dart-1.stem: In Flutter, what is almost everything you see on screen?

flutter_dart-2.stem: Which language is used to write Flutter apps?

flutter_dart-3.stem: What is the difference between a StatelessWidget and a StatefulWidget?
options: A stateful widget holds state that can change and rebuild it
A stateless widget holds state that can change over time and rebuild
A stateful widget cannot contain some child widgets
A stateless widget is usually rendered by the native platform view
flutter_dart-3.explanation: A StatefulWidget holds mutable state and rebuilds when setState is called; a StatelessWidget does not change on its own.

flutter_dart-4.stem: Which widget lets you build a long scrolling list efficiently, creating items only when needed?

flutter_dart-5.stem: Several screens need to share and react to the same app data. Which approach is idiomatic in Flutter?
options: Use a state-management package such as Provider, Riverpod or Bloc
Pass the data through the constructor of each screen
Store it in a global variable that some file can edit during the project
Reload the data from the server on each screen build
flutter_dart-5.explanation: Use a state-management solution such as Provider, Riverpod or Bloc rather than passing data through every constructor.

ios_swift-1.stem: Which IDE is used to develop iOS apps?

options: A declarative UI framework from Apple
A package manager for Swift libraries and tools
A database framework for iOS from the start
A tool for testing app performance in practice
ios_swift-2.explanation: Apple's declarative framework for building user interfaces across its platforms.

ios_swift-3.stem: What does an optional (String?) in Swift mean?
options: The value can be a string or nil
The string is usually empty within the team
The string cannot be changed after it is created
The string is stored on the disk of the device
ios_swift-3.explanation: The value may be a string or nil.

ios_swift-4.stem: Which property wrapper in SwiftUI stores local view state that refreshes the view when it changes?

ios_swift-5.stem: Which tool distributes beta builds of an iOS app to testers before release?

mobile_backend_services-1.stem: What is Firebase Authentication used for?
options: Signing users in with email, phone or social accounts
Compressing images before they are uploaded
Compiling the app for several platforms
Measuring the speed of the network
mobile_backend_services-1.explanation: Signing users in with email, phone or providers such as Google.

mobile_backend_services-2.stem: Which Firebase service sends push notifications?

mobile_backend_services-3.stem: An app must keep working without internet and sync later. What is this called?
options: Offline-first with local storage and later sync
Polling the server in a tight loop
Caching just the app icon on the device in most cases
mobile_backend_services-3.explanation: Offline-first design with local storage and background sync.

mobile_backend_services-4.stem: Which tool reports crashes from real users with stack traces?

mobile_backend_services-5.stem: Where should an API secret key used to call a paid service be kept?
options: On your own server that makes the call for the app
Inside the app code in a constant
In the strings file of the app
mobile_backend_services-5.explanation: On your own server, which proxies the call; keys inside the app can be extracted.

mobile_release_quality-1.stem: Where are Android apps published for public download?

mobile_release_quality-2.stem: Why must an app be signed before release?
options: To prove who published it and that it was not altered
To make the app smaller to download
To let the app run without internet access
To give the app permission to use the camera for the project
mobile_release_quality-2.explanation: The signature proves who published it and that it has not been altered.

options: Releasing to a growing share of users while monitoring
Releasing just to the developers of the app
Releasing the same build under several names in many setups
Releasing after each test has been rewritten in a real project
mobile_release_quality-3.explanation: Releasing a new version to a growing percentage of users while watching for problems.

mobile_release_quality-4.stem: Which tool automates building, signing and uploading mobile app releases?

mobile_release_quality-5.stem: Crash-free sessions dropped from 99.5% to 96% after a release. What is the best action?
options: Halt the rollout and investigate with crash reports
Wait a whole month to see if it improves on its own by then
Ask users to reinstall the app twice for the project
Raise the star rating target in the store in day-to-day work
mobile_release_quality-5.explanation: Halt the rollout, investigate with crash reports and fix or roll back.

react_native-1.stem: What does React Native let you do?
options: Build iOS and Android apps with React and JavaScript
Build just websites that run in a browser at that stage
Build desktop games with a physics engine
react_native-1.explanation: Build native mobile apps for iOS and Android with React and JavaScript.

react_native-2.stem: Which tool simplifies starting and running a React Native project without native setup?

react_native-3.stem: Which component should you use to render a long scrolling list?

react_native-4.stem: Which library is commonly used for screen navigation in React Native?

react_native-5.stem: An animation stutters because it runs on the JavaScript thread. What helps?
options: Run it on the UI thread with Reanimated or the native driver
Add more state variables to the component as the work grows for the business
Reduce the length of the animation to one frame in most teams
Re-render the whole screen on each frame for the business in most cases
react_native-5.explanation: Use the native driver or Reanimated so animations run on the UI thread.
